methodology.grounding: Exact displayed quotations and citation metadata verified against actual authorized retrieval; false abstentions fail factual cases.
methodology.hallucination_error: Rule-based proxy: unsupported quotations, false abstentions, output validation errors, or HTTP errors. Expected simulated errors are included. No semantic judge or LLM-as-judge.
methodology.latency: Measured API query plus first automated decision; excludes setup, ingestion and replay verification. Human waiting time is not measured.
methodology.demo: Deterministic source extraction; these scores do not measure NVIDIA NIM generation quality.
methodology.simulation: Failure cases use httpx.MockTransport and are identified separately; no provider calls occur in them.
